In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Declaration of a New Order|reformed]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[King/Legends|King]] [[Mitar]], the ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daimar]], refused to submit to the new regime. In respone, the Empire '''blockaded''' Daimar and as a result of the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]], the people of Daimar began to starve. Mitar realized that he would eventually have to surrender, so he arranged for his grand-daughter [[Wilena]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Alet Komain]] and a small group of individuals that he didn't want to be captured by the Empire to leave Daimar in the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Wasaka]]'' and run the blockade. However, just as the ''Wasaka'' attempted to flee the world, an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] started to bombard the planet, while Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] landed in Daimar's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] and attacked the [[Daimar Royal Palace]], Mitar's seat of power. The ''Wasaka'' engaged in combat with a number of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] and entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], successfully fleeing the planet.
